steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each team's bookings are matched to the monthly total. A total that differs is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 total does not match its rows

findings.title: Total does not match its rows
findings.fix: Recompute the total from the rows

findings.title: Win rate with no closed count
findings.fix: Show the closed count beside the rate

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] month-total.csv:12  Total does not match its rows.
       Fix: Recompute the total from the rows.
[medium] team-west.csv:19  Team missing from the export.
       Fix: Get the team's export.
[low] team-south.csv:26  Win rate with no closed count.
       Fix: Show the closed count beside the rate.
Not checked: Revenue recognition; the ledger itself.
pros: Checks a total that does not match its rows, a win rate with no closed count, and a team missing from the export.
cons: Not checked: Revenue recognition; the ledger itself.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-sales-monthly-results skill on the records for this review.
